blocks.text:
## Adventure through jungles, rivers and volcanoes

The journey starts in San José and soon leaves the city behind for Costa Rica's national parks. At Tortuguero, the road ends at a boat dock and the route continues along tropical waterways. On the Pacuare River, you stay at a riverside lodge in primary rainforest rather than a conventional hotel. The pace increases at Arenal with waterfall rappelling, ATV adventures and hot springs. Monteverde adds walks through mountain forests, bungee jumping and a kilometre-long zipline ride.

The final days take place on the Pacific coast. The pace changes as beach relaxation alternates with sport fishing and diving near the Catalina Islands.

The itinerary crosses dramatically different natural regions. One morning you may be walking through misty forest; a few days later, you could be admiring a volcano or arriving at the ocean. Even the transfers are part of the experience: the route to Tortuguero passes through Braulio Carrillo National Park and banana plantations, while the road to Monteverde brings waterfalls and views of the Gulf of Nicoya. Activities vary in intensity, from kayaking and rafting to canyoning, ATV riding and bungee jumping, with free time on the beach between the fishing and diving excursions.
